name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations Manager | HubSpot, Lifecycle Automation & Reporting
summary: Marketing operations leader and CRM architect with 15+ years in marketing and revenue operations, including 5+ years building CRM and marketing-automation systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot: properties, lists, segmentation, workflows, forms, nurture and lifecycle sequences, and the dashboards that show what is working. Turns campaign briefs from non-technical owners into reliable builds, QAs them before launch, and automates the manual work around them with Zapier, Make, n8n, and AI-assisted workflows. A decade in B2B SaaS account roles with long sales cycles means the builds are designed around how Sales actually uses the data.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and administer CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot for B2B service clients: custom properties, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, and strict data-hygiene protocols.

Architected and deployed a complete marketing-automation system of 20+ workflows: lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture and reactivation, and review-generation sequences.
Built segmented email outreach campaigns plus an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger personalized follow-up.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, using GA4 and CRM analytics to keep source and attribution data consistent.
Connect CRMs to client sites and tools with Zapier, Make, and n8n (including custom Python/JavaScript code steps), and install Google Tag Manager and GA4 tracking directly in HTML/CSS.
Implement AI-assisted workflows that remove manual campaign and reporting steps, translating non-technical owners' briefs into precise automation logic and prompt instructions.
Design monitoring loops and rubric-based QA to catch broken automation logic before it reaches customers, keeping builds running across concurrent client engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built campaign performance reporting frameworks in a HubSpot environment tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced campaign assets including landing pages, multi-step email sequences, and conversion-focused copy that supported lead generation and pipeline.
Coordinated integrated campaigns across inbound, paid media, and content, aligning execution across internal departments to launch on schedule.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K) in Salesforce, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Guided partners through technical setup and configuration of marketing automation and reputation tools, and analyzed utilization data to flag adoption gaps.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built and refined internal processes in a HubSpot-based agency stack that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), building process improvements and training for a new vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, selling CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, and built Zapier automations, troubleshooting technical issues during setup.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
